name: LearningSupportPlan
tagline: IEP, 504 and SEN support plans with live progress monitoring – in one PCF control.
description: A Power Platform code component for an individual learning support plan. It covers goals with aim lines and trend projection, an accommodations × context matrix, service-minute delivery, the review cycle, progress notes, a family view and sign-off. It runs in Canvas apps, Model-driven apps and Power Pages. Documentation aid only.
features: Goal progress monitoring with aim line, trend and automatic status
Accommodations matrix by context (classroom, homework, tests, exams) with keyboard support
Review timeline with overdue detection and next-review scheduling
Edit, review, family and read-only modes
Teacher summary output and change event
